DealBazaar.pk 7 Days Checking & Replacement Warranty

At DealBazaar.pk, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We are committed to providing a secure, reliable, and hassle-free online shopping experience across Pakistan.

"If You're Not Happy, We're Not Happy."
Every eligible product purchased from DealBazaar.pk comes with a 7-Day Checking & Replacement Warranty for complete peace of mind.

What is the 7-Day Checking & Replacement Warranty?

Our warranty allows customers up to 7 days (168 hours) from the date of delivery to inspect and verify that the product is working properly and matches the order placed.

If you receive a product with a manufacturing defect, operational issue, or incorrect item, you may request a replacement within the warranty period.

Important Notice for Damaged Deliveries

If your parcel arrives physically damaged, broken, incomplete, or tampered with, please notify our support team within 24 hours of delivery.

Contact Information

📧 Email: dealbzr@gmail.com

📱 WhatsApp & Helpline: +92 310 2492119

Eligible Replacement Cases

1. Incorrect Product Delivered

The item delivered does not match the product ordered on DealBazaar.pk.

2. Defective or Faulty Product

The product has a manufacturing defect, operational fault, or does not function as intended upon first use.

Conditions for Replacement Approval

  • Product must be unused, undamaged, and in original condition.
  • Original packaging, manuals, warranty cards, and accessories must be included.
  • No signs of misuse, alteration, or unauthorized repair.
  • Warranty seals and serial numbers must remain intact.
  • Product must not be scratched, marked, or physically damaged.

How to Request a Replacement

  1. Contact DealBazaar.pk Customer Support.
  2. Provide your Order Number and issue details.
  3. Share images or videos if requested.
  4. Once verified, we will process your replacement promptly.

Non-Eligible Replacement Cases

  • Physical damage reported after 24 hours of delivery.
  • Damage caused by misuse or improper installation.
  • Missing packaging, accessories, or warranty cards.
  • Liquid damage, accidents, or power fluctuation damage.
  • Change of mind after purchase.

Limitation of Liability

DealBazaar.pk shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages including loss of profits, data, or business interruption resulting from the use of products or services purchased through our platform.
